latestVersion.changelog:
Self-Improvement Skill v1.0.0 — initial release supporting structured learning and error logging for continuous agent improvement.

- Logs errors, learnings, and feature requests to dedicated markdown files for future processing.
- Provides detailed templates and categories for learnings, errors, and feature requests.
- Guides users to promote broadly applicable learnings to project memory (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, etc).
- Integrates with OpenClaw for workspace-based session memory and inter-session communication.
- Includes installation, setup, and workflow instructions for OpenClaw and generic agent environments.
- Supports status tracking and resolution documentation for each learning or error entry.
